newsitem.title: UK: General Accident slips on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: General Accident slips on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares in insurance group General Accident slipped on Wednesday amid profit-taking after the recent surge in the stock over the past month, dealers said.
The shares which have risen over 100p -- 16 percent -- since the beginning of September, were 19p lower at 725-1/2p by early afternoon.
Commercial Union, another in the sector which has seen repeated share price strength also slipped back, dropping 7p to 658-1/2p.
Guardian Royal Exchange was down 3p at 264p and Royal & Sun Alliance 3p at 425p.
